entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6639"/><div sID="gen10165" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6639"/><hi type="bold">3. thy ... name--</hi>perfections of justice, power, &c.<div eID="gen10165" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10166" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">great and terrible name--</hi>producing dread (<reference osisRef="Deut.10.17">De 10:17</reference>), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted (<reference osisRef="Ps.97.9">Psa 97:9</reference>).<div eID="gen10166" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10167" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">it is holy--</hi>or, "He is holy" (<reference osisRef="Ps.99.5">Psa 99:5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Ps.99.9">9</reference>; <reference osisRef="Isa.6.3">Is 6:3</reference>). <div eID="gen10167" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 3. thy ... name-- perfections of justice, power, &c. great and terrible name-- producing dread ( De 10:17 ), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted ( Psa 97:9 ). it is holy-- or, "He is holy" ( Psa 99:5 , 9 ; Is 6:3 ).
entries.reader_content_plain: 3. thy ... name-- perfections of justice, power, &c. great and terrible name-- producing dread ( De 10:17 ), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted ( Psa 97:9 ). it is holy-- or, "He is holy" ( Psa 99:5 , 9 ; Is 6:3 ).
